About Me

Building practical data skills.

A concise introduction to my current analytics journey and focus.

I am an aspiring Data Analyst currently developing practical skills through the AI Driven Data Analytics Career Track at Ostad. My current focus is on data cleaning, analysis, visualization and reporting using Microsoft Excel, Power Query, Power Pivot, DAX and SQL.


Through hands-on assignments and assessments, I have worked with sales, HR and business datasets to transform raw data into structured analysis, dashboards and reports.
